evaluation_policy.height_reservation: Neither height used in demonstration fitting or live engineering development before declaration
evaluation_policy.model_policy: Reuse the original nine-demonstration model; no refitting
evaluation_policy.execution_policy: Same source fingerprint and controller as the completed paired eighteen-cell pilot
evaluation_policy.conclusions: Descriptive supplementary simulation pilot; no statistical superiority claim

completed.requirement: Completed status and exactly 1 completed cycles

cycle_labels.requirement: Every requested cycle appears in chronological order

sample_clock.requirement: Continuous end-of-interval sampling with no reset or time gap

control_alignment.requirement: Control timestamp equals interval endpoint minus dt

mpc_update_cadence.requirement: MPC updates match the configured fixed-step cadence, initialization, and immediate support changes; no missing or unexplained solves

qp_success.requirement: Every MPC update has QP status 0

nlp_status.requirement: Post-settling MPC NLP status is 0 or 2

selected_force_cap.requirement: Desired selected-foot vertical force <= configured cap + 1 N at MPC updates

body_tilt.requirement: Maximum absolute roll or pitch < 8 degrees

cycle_1_phase_order.requirement: All stages occur once in stand→shift→unload→lift→hold→lower→confirm→reload→recenter order

cycle_1_hold_duration.requirement: Continuous hold >= 5 s with at most one sample of boundary tolerance

cycle_1_hold_contact.requirement: Selected foot has neither contact nor planned support; other three have both for every hold sample

cycle_1_swing_schedule.requirement: Selected planned support remains off and the other three remain on throughout lift/hold/lower/confirm

cycle_1_support_contact_continuity.requirement: All three support feet retain measured contact throughout unload/lift/hold/lower/confirm/reload

cycle_1_hold_clearance.requirement: Selected foot remains >= 20 mm above its fixed pre-lift center height throughout hold

cycle_1_support_margin.requirement: Physical CoM projection has >= 10 mm margin inside measured three-foot support triangle during hold

cycle_1_fixed_lift_reference.requirement: Immutable lift anchor and constant hold target 0.03 m above it, with zero desired velocity/acceleration

cycle_1_foot_tracking.requirement: Selected-foot 3D error < 12 mm during lift, hold, lower and confirm

cycle_1_support_slip.requirement: All three support feet stay within 10 mm of their fixed positions at shift entry

cycle_1_lift_entry_guard.requirement: Last unload sample before lift: selected normal < 3 N, each support > 5 N, physical margin >= 20 mm, selected cap <= 0.1 N

cycle_1_force_cap_ramps.requirement: Unload and reload each last >= 3 s; held MPC force cap decreases monotonically on unload and increases on reload

cycle_1_reload_gate.requirement: Reload follows confirm and recorded dwell >= 0.1 s; preceding contacts independently active at >= 2 N for that debounce minus at most one boundary sample

cycle_1_reload_loading.requirement: All four feet have measured/planned contact and normal force > 5 N for the last 0.2 s of reload and first recenter sample

final_four_foot_stance.requirement: Final complete phase lasts >= 1 s with all four feet in measured and planned contact

final_four_foot_loading.requirement: Every foot remains loaded above 5 N throughout the final complete phase (at least 1 s), with measured and planned contact

pad_reference_limit_configuration.requirement: Declared reference limits are positive and no looser than the shared executor limits

pad_finite_planner_signals.requirement: All recorded planner, belief, and applied reference quantities are finite

pad_commanded_foot_speed.requirement: Applied foot-position differences during lowering/confirmation respect the nominal speed limit

pad_commanded_com_speed.requirement: Applied CoM-position differences respect the shared body-speed limit

pad_monotone_lowering.requirement: Applied foot Z never rises during lowering or contact confirmation

pad_commanded_body_displacement.requirement: Each CoM coordinate stays within the permitted displacement from lowering entry

pad_commanded_target_xy.requirement: The selected foot reference stays within the nominal landing-target XY bounds

pad_commanded_orientation.requirement: Each body-orientation reference coordinate respects displacement and rate limits

pad_contact_reference_freeze.requirement: Applied body and foot positions remain fixed while loaded contact is being confirmed

pad_planner_update_cadence.requirement: Planner updates at 20 Hz while active, pauses for loaded-contact debounce, and updates immediately on resume

pad_commanded_recovery_speed.requirement: Segments planned after sensed missing contact respect bounded slow descent, allowing one planning-tick latency

pad_configuration.requirement: One landing-pad cycle with finite geometry and bounded search settings

pad_fixed_support_surfaces.requirement: All four fixed launch/support surfaces have top z=0; only the separate landing pad changes

pad_truth_separation_schema.requirement: Actual height appears only in evaluation metadata; known height labels are confined to demonstrations

pad_bounded_descent.requirement: Commanded foot bottom stays above initial estimate minus search depth and contact compression

pad_physical_reach.requirement: Measured foot bottom never extends more than 40 mm below the initial estimate

pad_foot_bottom_consistency.requirement: Evaluation foot-bottom signal equals measured sphere center minus known radius

pad_target_force_consistency.requirement: Target-pad forces/contact are a nonnegative subset of measured selected-foot ground contact

pad_final_target_loading.requirement: Final standing loads the actual separate target pad above 5 N and stays within 20 mm of its center

pad_final_height_consistency.requirement: Loaded final foot bottom is within 5 mm of the simulator's true pad top, allowing contact compliance

pad_target_contact_before_reload.requirement: Independent target-pad contact carries at least 2 N throughout the pre-reload debounce window

pad_target_reload_loading.requirement: Actual target pad is loaded above 5 N over the last 0.2 s of reload and first recenter sample

pad_belief_bounds.requirement: Belief has nonnegative uncertainty and ordered lower/mean/upper values

pad_sensor_causality.requirement: Sensor timestamps are monotonic and never later than the consuming control interval start

pad_planner_execution.requirement: Planner executes with finite nonnegative timing; bounded recovery fallback is reported separately

conventions.impact: Simulated target-pad normal reaction over exactly 100 ms after first physical target contact; impulse is the rectangle-rule integral, including static load.
conventions.body_disturbance: Roll/pitch change from lowering entry and CoM tracking error are reported separately from intentionally commanded body motion.
conventions.timing: Physical contact time uses post-step evaluation contacts. Nominal deadline is lowering entry plus requested nominal duration; approximately planned means within 0.25 s. This descriptive label is not an acceptance criterion.
conventions.height_truth: Actual height is used only by the simulator and this evaluator. Schema checks do not prove absence of arbitrary numeric information leaks; planner API tests and code review complement them.
conventions.completion: All inherited controlled-step criteria and additional pad checks must pass. No relative planner superiority is assumed.

pad_planner_execution.requirement: Planner executes with finite nonnegative timing; bounded recovery fallback is reported separately

conventions.impact: Simulated target-pad normal reaction over exactly 100 ms after first physical target contact; impulse is the rectangle-rule integral, including static load.
conventions.body_disturbance: Roll/pitch change from lowering entry and CoM tracking error are reported separately from intentionally commanded body motion.
conventions.timing: Physical contact time uses post-step evaluation contacts. Nominal deadline is lowering entry plus requested nominal duration; approximately planned means within 0.25 s. This descriptive label is not an acceptance criterion.
conventions.height_truth: Actual height is used only by the simulator and this evaluator. Schema checks do not prove absence of arbitrary numeric information leaks; planner API tests and code review complement them.
conventions.completion: All inherited controlled-step criteria and additional pad checks must pass. No relative planner superiority is assumed.

completed.requirement: Completed status and exactly 1 completed cycles

cycle_labels.requirement: Every requested cycle appears in chronological order

sample_clock.requirement: Continuous end-of-interval sampling with no reset or time gap

control_alignment.requirement: Control timestamp equals interval endpoint minus dt

mpc_update_cadence.requirement: MPC updates match the configured fixed-step cadence, initialization, and immediate support changes; no missing or unexplained solves

qp_success.requirement: Every MPC update has QP status 0

nlp_status.requirement: Post-settling MPC NLP status is 0 or 2

selected_force_cap.requirement: Desired selected-foot vertical force <= configured cap + 1 N at MPC updates

body_tilt.requirement: Maximum absolute roll or pitch < 8 degrees

cycle_1_phase_order.requirement: All stages occur once in stand→shift→unload→lift→hold→lower→confirm→reload→recenter order

cycle_1_hold_duration.requirement: Continuous hold >= 5 s with at most one sample of boundary tolerance

cycle_1_hold_contact.requirement: Selected foot has neither contact nor planned support; other three have both for every hold sample

cycle_1_swing_schedule.requirement: Selected planned support remains off and the other three remain on throughout lift/hold/lower/confirm

cycle_1_support_contact_continuity.requirement: All three support feet retain measured contact throughout unload/lift/hold/lower/confirm/reload

cycle_1_hold_clearance.requirement: Selected foot remains >= 20 mm above its fixed pre-lift center height throughout hold

cycle_1_support_margin.requirement: Physical CoM projection has >= 10 mm margin inside measured three-foot support triangle during hold

cycle_1_fixed_lift_reference.requirement: Immutable lift anchor and constant hold target 0.03 m above it, with zero desired velocity/acceleration

cycle_1_foot_tracking.requirement: Selected-foot 3D error < 12 mm during lift, hold, lower and confirm

cycle_1_support_slip.requirement: All three support feet stay within 10 mm of their fixed positions at shift entry

cycle_1_lift_entry_guard.requirement: Last unload sample before lift: selected normal < 3 N, each support > 5 N, physical margin >= 20 mm, selected cap <= 0.1 N

cycle_1_force_cap_ramps.requirement: Unload and reload each last >= 3 s; held MPC force cap decreases monotonically on unload and increases on reload

cycle_1_reload_gate.requirement: Reload follows confirm and recorded dwell >= 0.1 s; preceding contacts independently active at >= 2 N for that debounce minus at most one boundary sample

cycle_1_reload_loading.requirement: All four feet have measured/planned contact and normal force > 5 N for the last 0.2 s of reload and first recenter sample

final_four_foot_stance.requirement: Final complete phase lasts >= 1 s with all four feet in measured and planned contact

final_four_foot_loading.requirement: Every foot remains loaded above 5 N throughout the final complete phase (at least 1 s), with measured and planned contact

pad_reference_limit_configuration.requirement: Declared reference limits are positive and no looser than the shared executor limits

pad_finite_planner_signals.requirement: All recorded planner, belief, and applied reference quantities are finite

pad_commanded_foot_speed.requirement: Applied foot-position differences during lowering/confirmation respect the nominal speed limit

pad_commanded_com_speed.requirement: Applied CoM-position differences respect the shared body-speed limit

pad_monotone_lowering.requirement: Applied foot Z never rises during lowering or contact confirmation

pad_commanded_body_displacement.requirement: Each CoM coordinate stays within the permitted displacement from lowering entry

pad_commanded_target_xy.requirement: The selected foot reference stays within the nominal landing-target XY bounds

pad_commanded_orientation.requirement: Each body-orientation reference coordinate respects displacement and rate limits

pad_contact_reference_freeze.requirement: Applied body and foot positions remain fixed while loaded contact is being confirmed

pad_planner_update_cadence.requirement: Planner updates at 20 Hz while active, pauses for loaded-contact debounce, and updates immediately on resume

pad_commanded_recovery_speed.requirement: Segments planned after sensed missing contact respect bounded slow descent, allowing one planning-tick latency

pad_configuration.requirement: One landing-pad cycle with finite geometry and bounded search settings

pad_fixed_support_surfaces.requirement: All four fixed launch/support surfaces have top z=0; only the separate landing pad changes

pad_truth_separation_schema.requirement: Actual height appears only in evaluation metadata; known height labels are confined to demonstrations

pad_bounded_descent.requirement: Commanded foot bottom stays above initial estimate minus search depth and contact compression

pad_physical_reach.requirement: Measured foot bottom never extends more than 40 mm below the initial estimate

pad_foot_bottom_consistency.requirement: Evaluation foot-bottom signal equals measured sphere center minus known radius

pad_target_force_consistency.requirement: Target-pad forces/contact are a nonnegative subset of measured selected-foot ground contact

pad_final_target_loading.requirement: Final standing loads the actual separate target pad above 5 N and stays within 20 mm of its center

pad_final_height_consistency.requirement: Loaded final foot bottom is within 5 mm of the simulator's true pad top, allowing contact compliance

pad_target_contact_before_reload.requirement: Independent target-pad contact carries at least 2 N throughout the pre-reload debounce window

pad_target_reload_loading.requirement: Actual target pad is loaded above 5 N over the last 0.2 s of reload and first recenter sample

pad_belief_bounds.requirement: Belief has nonnegative uncertainty and ordered lower/mean/upper values

pad_sensor_causality.requirement: Sensor timestamps are monotonic and never later than the consuming control interval start

pad_planner_execution.requirement: Planner executes with finite nonnegative timing; bounded recovery fallback is reported separately

interpretation: Descriptive pilot with one seed and one attempt per planner/height/sensing cell. The ±7.5 mm heights were predeclared before these trials and were excluded from demonstration fitting and live engineering development. Sensing is clean. The original trained model and the controller/source from the paired eighteen-cell pilot remain fixed; no refitting uses these six trials. Failed and missing cells remain visible. Impact and completion summaries below use successful trials only, so compare them alongside success and coverage. These data do not establish statistical superiority.
impact_convention: Measured simulated pad-normal reaction during the first 100 ms after physical contact, including static load.
body_convention: Roll/pitch change from lowering entry; intentional body motion contributes. CoM reference error is separately recorded.
